# Correctness evidence — predecessor source 6c9b16b

Source: `6c9b16b02a5393ae982cec33784e151c3aeed519`. The [focused CI job](https://github.com/dnikolayev/hash/actions/runs/34628385406/job/103358941311) passed 27 helper checks, five Rust cache-line probe checks, and six timing-parser checks. Helper tests use synthetic source trees, metadata, tools and compiler outputs; the locking test uses real POSIX processes, and the archive test uses real tar. They do not substitute for native Cargo or integration execution.

The exact names below are in the [measured helper test file](https://github.com/dnikolayev/hash/blob/6c9b16b02a5393ae982cec33784e151c3aeed519/.github/actions/graph-build-cache/graph_build_cache_test.py).

| Requirement | Focused test evidence | Native evidence / limit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Direct/transitive source, generated inputs, deletion | `test_source_changes_include_transitive_non_rust_generated_and_deletions` | Accepted native source-proof retry: both compiler-error probes, valid transitive rebuild and complete recovery passed. |
| Unrelated edits stay reusable; relevant closure changes invalidate | `test_unrelated_files_and_disconnected_packages_keep_the_key`; `test_resolution_rejects_missing_ambiguous_or_external_inputs` | Accepted native retry: unrelated documentation kept the exact key, restored through the helper and was reverted exactly. |
| Toolchain file, tool/compiler identity and features | `test_source_changes_include_transitive_non_rust_generated_and_deletions` includes `rust-toolchain.toml`; `test_key_binds_resolution_environment_tools_platform_and_absolute_path`; `test_real_environment_function_resolves_shims_before_isolating` | Synthetic tool/feature changes; no separate native changed-toolchain experiment is claimed. |
| Custom flags, profiles, targets and external configuration | `test_custom_flags_targets_and_profiles_fall_back`; `test_unsupported_config_and_external_sources_reject_reuse`; `test_disabled_or_unsupported_uses_original_command_and_environment` | Synthetic rejection and exact original-command/environment fallback checks. |
| Relevant environment changes; unrelated values excluded | `test_key_binds_resolution_environment_tools_platform_and_absolute_path`; `test_real_environment_function_resolves_shims_before_isolating`; `test_sccache_port_is_a_build_input_and_unrelated_variables_are_not` | No claim that every variable with a compiler-like prefix is excluded; see the source-proof failure below. |
| Exact restore and checksum validation | `test_exact_hit_restores_only_binary_without_compiling`; `test_corrupt_missing_wrong_arch_nonexecutable_and_symlink_payloads_miss` | Five accepted fresh-runner Actions restores in the native warm run, with matching input keys and payload manifests. |
| Shared-inode corruption and Cargo retained-output safety | `test_mutation_through_shared_runtime_inode_rejects_reuse`; `test_corrupted_snapshot_recovers_from_fresh_cargo_dependency_output`; `test_changed_inputs_and_cargo_replacement_preserve_old_payload_inode` | Synthetic valid-ELF-body corruption and Cargo uplift simulation, not a native fault-injection run. |
| Concurrent helpers and fallback serialization | `test_concurrent_compilers_and_fallback_share_one_lock`; `test_prepare_lock_failure_restores_original_command_and_disables_reuse` | Real process/lock scheduling with a synthetic compiler. Production upload validation uses the same lock. |
| Archive portability and atomic-copy fallback | `test_tar_payload_restores_without_external_hardlink`; `test_copy_fallback_and_atomic_staging_cleanup` | Native Actions transfer/restore also exercised; no external hardlink is required in the payload archive. |
| Failed builds or inputs changing during compilation cannot publish | `test_changed_inputs_and_failed_or_invalid_build_do_not_publish` | Accepted native retry: direct/transitive compiler errors left the original payload unchanged. |

The complete [cold run 34625071470](https://github.com/dnikolayev/hash/actions/runs/34625071470) and [warm run 34628385406](https://github.com/dnikolayev/hash/actions/runs/34628385406) both completed with 77 successful jobs and one skipped job. The warm run accepted all five exact-key Actions restores without initial graph Cargo compilation. Matched producer/consumer payload digests, current helper events and unchanged selected-test counts support four observed cross-CPU-model reuses and one same-CPU-model Playwright reuse; no independent hash of a running process was collected. This is observed compatibility, not a universal portability claim.

Native behavior counts matched: Playwright 32 passed/8 skipped; backend 110 passed/9 skipped plus 48 additional passed tests; graph integration 130 passed; HTTP 49 setup and 181 test requests succeeded; benches 86 Criterion cases. Startup, migrations, readiness checks and selected integration commands still executed. These correctness observations do not establish a workflow performance improvement.

The [source-proof attempt 34631383962](https://github.com/dnikolayev/hash/actions/runs/34631383962/job/103368764200) remains **failed and unaccepted**. It demonstrated an actual initial cache hit, unchanged-key documentation edit, direct and transitive compile-error invalidation, valid transitive rebuilding, and normal backend startup/tests. During final recovery, original source bytes and the payload manifest were restored, but Codecov had exported compiler-prefix environment variables before key verification. The final original-key assertion failed; the live executable had been unlinked, final helper restoration did not execute, and the temporary backup remained. The exact recovery fingerprint components were not retained. No Actions cache save was present in this workflow.

The [source-proof retry 34634365267](https://github.com/dnikolayev/hash/actions/runs/34634365267/job/103378562633) **passed and is accepted**. It repeated the invalidation checks, ran the valid transitive rebuild through normal backend startup and tests (110 passed/9 skipped plus 48 passed), then verified exact original source/payload/key restoration, a final helper cache hit and temporary-backup removal. Its diagnostic workflow moved the identical coverage-upload block after recovery; the measured predecessor source is unchanged. The [compact receipt](correctness.json) retains both attempts and their source/workflow/script identities. Filesystem facts follow assertions in the checksum-verified proof script; no independent final runner filesystem snapshot was recorded. Both attempts are excluded from performance measurements.
